entities.name: Hermann Otto I of Limburg-Styrum
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hermann Otto I of Limburg-Styrum, count of Limburg and Bronckhorst, lord of Styrum, Gemen, Wisch and Borculo, and from 1640 to 1644 advocate of the imperial abbey of Vreden, was born in about 1592, and died on 17 October 1644. He was the eldest son of Jobst of Limburg Stirum.
